d: FM Slim once said that , “The Almighty created in the Gurkhas an ideal infantryman, indeed an ideal Rifleman, brave , tough, patient, adaptable, skilled in field craft, intensely proud of his military record and unswerving loyalty “ The fearless warriors are the most feared and bravest soldiers who have won the respect of even their enemies. With the spine – chilling war cry ‘ Jai Mahakali , Ayo Gorkhali ‘ the regiment has done us Proud.
